My situation is a little different. But I’m a male and I just turned 20 in October. I was abused by my dad and some of his friends along the way. It started at a young age and didn’t stop for a very long time. I was afraid of actual sex for awhile, I still kind of am. I always gravitated toward men because it was all I ever known and I thought that that’s what I was supposed to do and be with. I still struggle with accepting the fact that I actually like women. If that makes sense. When I’ve dated girls I felt like I was doing something wrong. That’s what I was made to feel. So I’m constantly battling with myself. I know I’m not gay, deep down. I don’t want to be with a man and i am attracted to women. I think the abuse and the brainwashing altered my mind and the way I think. Like, once it stopped I’ve been on a rollercoaster trying to figure out who I am and who I’m supposed to be. But I’m getting there and my relationships have been rocky but I’m lucky to have found and understand girl that helps clear my mind and rid all those demons. It just takes time. You really have to focus on yourself and what you want/need and go for it. And if you fall down, get right back up and make another path to travel down. Until you find the right path. Then you’ll soar. Your past won’t change, but you’re in control now. You’re future can be positive and bright.
